description: This file contains the implementation of a fixed-size BitSet class in Scala, used within Apache Spark's utility collection package. It provides bit manipulation operations such as set, clear, union, intersection, and iteration over set bits.

classes.name: BitSet
classes.description: A simple, fixed-size bit set implementation optimized for speed by avoiding safety checks.

methods.name: capacity
methods.description: Returns the total number of bits the BitSet can represent.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears all bits in the BitSet.

methods.name: setUntil
methods.description: Sets all bits up to a specified index.

methods.name: clearUntil
methods.description: Clears all bits up to a specified index.

methods.name: andNot
methods.description: Performs bitwise AND-NOT with another BitSet.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets the bit at a specific index.

methods.name: unset
methods.description: Clears the bit at a specific index.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Returns whether the bit at a specific index is set.

methods.name: iterator
methods.description: Provides an iterator over the indices of set bits.

methods.name: cardinality
methods.description: Counts the number of bits set to true.

methods.name: nextSetBit
methods.description: Finds the index of the next set bit at or after a given index.

methods.name: union
methods.description: Performs in-place union with another BitSet.

methods.name: intersects
methods.description: Checks if there is any intersection with another BitSet.
